notes.title: Hero Hours Contract 2: Now Available to Wishlist!
notes.content:
Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls, is now available to wishlist on Steam!

Join the [b]Magical Science Angel[/b], [b]Genius Beauty Knight[/b] and [b]Magical Girl (Provisional) 917B[/b] (Just call her 'Bea') as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics.

Magical Girls are mysteriously disappearing, a suspicious new App has monopolised the magical job market, and something seems to be draining all the electricity in the city...

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092520/Hero_Hours_Contract_2_A_Factory_for_Magical_Girls/]Visit the Steam page here![/url]

notes.title: Hero Hours Contract 2: Now in development!
notes.content:
I'm happy to confirm that Hero Hours Contract 2 is now in development!

You can try out a very early prototype demo over at [url=https://rainsdowne.itch.io/hero-hours-contract-2-prototype-demo]Itch.io[/url].

Things are still in the very early stages of development, but you can follow along on [url=https://twitter.com/sogormangames]Twitter[/url] for regular updates on the game's progress.

In the meantime, please enjoy this message from our Grand Sponsors:


[previewyoutube=8EEHEpVlvxg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1.4 Attack Cancelling
notes.content:
You can now cancel attacks and re-position yourself to choose a different target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35904569/8d6b9c844cabe3110969d3e6ef0ef431d557c786.gif[/img]

I should have added this sooner, so apolgies. I was a little wary of the chnages required to the battle flow, but things actually came together realyl easily!

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added difficulty options.
[*]Fixed issue where 'Make Demands' tutorial text was never showing for some users.
[/list]

notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.content:
It was such a pleasure to work with DDRKirby[ISQ], whose work I've admired for so long, on the Hero Hours Contract soundtrack. 

It's now [url=https://ddrkirbyisq.bandcamp.com/album/hero-hours-contract-original-soundtrack]available to purchase on Bandcamp![/url]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Quality of Life Changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added post-battle dialogs to guide players on how to level up the characters.
[*] First attempt at making demands during negotiation now much more likey to succeed.
[*] Shuffled starting stage order.
[*] Tweaked one of the coffee shop stages to make it more immediatley rewarding when solving the puzzle, instead of having to rely on luck.
[/list]
